extName.description: The extension name in the browser’s extension list.

extDescription.message: Add the current page, a link, an image, a mail or the selected text to your own OpenTodo server, from a small popup. It talks only to the server address you enter.
extDescription.description: The description in the browser’s extension list.

actionTitle.description: Toolbar button tooltip and the page context-menu entry.

commandDescription.message: Add the current page to OpenTodo
commandDescription.description: Keyboard shortcut description in the browser’s shortcut settings.

menuScreenshot.description: Context-menu entry that captures a screenshot.

optionsIntro.message: Enter the address of your OpenTodo server. The extension stores only this address and, in Quick save mode, the token you paste below; it talks to no other address.

pendingNote.message: Set your server to continue adding "$TITLE$".
pendingNote.description: Shown on first run; $TITLE$ is the page being captured.

thisPage.description: Fallback for a page without title or address.

serverLabel.description: Label of the server address field.

screenshotsIntro.message: "Add screenshot to OpenTodo" captures the visible part of a page and hands the image to your server's capture popup, where nothing is saved until you press Save. Handing it over needs access to your server's address, and only that address; the browser asks when you save it.

screenshotsNotAllowed.message: Screenshots: not allowed yet. The extension needs access to your server only to hand a screenshot to the capture popup.

allowScreenshots.description: Button that asks for access to the server address.

invalidAddress.message: Enter an http:// or https:// address, for example https://todo.example.com
invalidAddress.description: Error for an address that is not http(s).

popupLine.description: Label of the quick-add line in the popup.

popupInbox.description: The project picker’s choice for no project.

popupAddLabel.description: First entry of the label picker.

popupRemoveLabel.description: Accessible name of the button that removes a label; $NAME$ is the label.

popupOrigin.description: Label of the task’s origin (the page it comes from).

popupRemoveOrigin.description: Accessible name of the button that removes the page link.

popupOptions.description: Link from the popup to the options page.

popupOpenCapture.description: Button that opens the server’s capture screen instead.

popupSaving.description: Status while the task is being saved.

popupSaved.description: Status once the task was saved.

popupUnreachable.message: The server could not be reached. Your text is still here.
popupUnreachable.description: The server did not answer a save.

popupTokenRefused.message: The token no longer works. Check it in the settings.
popupTokenRefused.description: The token was refused by the server.

popupEncrypted.message: This account is end-to-end encrypted: save from the capture screen, which encrypts on your device.
popupEncrypted.description: Quick save on an end-to-end encrypted account.

popupRateLimited.message: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.

popupFailed.message: The task could not be saved: $MESSAGE$
popupFailed.description: A save failed; $MESSAGE$ is the server’s reason.

popupNoServer.message: Set your server address in the settings first; Save takes you there.
popupNoServer.description: The popup before a server address is set.

modeHeading.description: Options page heading of the save modes.

modeCaptureHelp.message: Save opens your server’s capture screen, where you check the task and save it. The extension holds no token and sends nothing itself.
modeCaptureHelp.description: What the Capture screen mode does.

modeQuickHelp.message: Save creates the task at once through your server’s API, with the token below. The extension sends the line, the selected text and the page address to your server, and to no one else.
modeQuickHelp.description: What the Quick save mode does.

modeNeedsToken.message: Quick save needs a full-access token: until then Save opens the capture screen.
modeNeedsToken.description: Quick save chosen without a token that can save.

tokenHelp.message: Create a full-access token in OpenTodo under Settings, Integrations, API tokens, and name it after this browser so you can revoke it on its own. It stays on this device: browsers never synchronise it.

tokenSave.description: Button that checks and saves the token.

tokenForgotten.message: The token was removed from this browser.
tokenForgotten.description: Status after the token was removed.

tokenChecking.description: Status while the token is checked.

tokenOk.message: Token of $NAME$ ($SCOPE$): Quick save is ready.
tokenOk.description: The token works; $NAME$ is the account, $SCOPE$ its scope.

tokenRead.message: This read-only token can preview a line but not save: Save keeps opening the capture screen.

tokenAgent.message: This token is for AI assistants and cannot save here; create a full-access token instead.
tokenAgent.description: An AI assistant token was given.

tokenRejected.description: The server refused the token; $MESSAGE$ is its reason.

tokenUnreachable.message: The server could not be reached.
tokenUnreachable.description: The server did not answer the token check.

tokenNoServer.description: A token was given before a server address.

tokenHttp.message: Tokens travel only over https. Use an https address (or localhost); the capture screen keeps working.
tokenHttp.description: A token for a plain http address.

tokenAccess.message: Quick save needs access to your server’s address; the browser did not grant it.
tokenAccess.description: The browser did not grant access to the server address.
